import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import SpectralClustering
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify highly correlated pairs
    corr_pairs = []
    for i, fid1 in enumerate(feats.ids):
        for j, fid2 in enumerate(feats.ids[i+1:], i+1):
            if abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:,i], feats.x[:,j])[0,1]) >= 0.6:
                corr_pairs.append((fid1, fid2))
    
    # Build adjacency matrix from correlations
    n = len(feats.ids)
    adj = np.zeros((n, n))
    for fid1, fid2 in corr_pairs:
        i, j = feats.column(fid1), feats.column(fid2)
        adj[i,j] = adj[j,i] = 1
    
    # Cluster features using spectral clustering
    if np.sum(adj) > 0:
        clustering = SpectralClustering(n_clusters=1, affinity='precomputed', 
                                       random_state=0).fit(adj)
        cluster_labels = clustering.labels_
        module_features = [feats.ids[i] for i in range(n) if cluster_labels[i] == 0]
    else:
        # No strong correlations, use top features by t-statistic
        t_stats = []
        for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
            y0 = feats.x[feats.y==0, i]
            y1 = feats.x[feats.y==1, i]
            t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(y0, y1)
            t_stats.append(abs(t_stat))
        top_indices = np.argsort(t_stats)[::-1][:5]
        module_features = [feats.ids[i] for i in top_indices]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (keep only one from each pair)
    unique_features = []
    seen = set()
    for fid in module_features:
        if fid not in seen:
            seen.add(fid)
            unique_features.append(fid)
    
    # Limit to maximum drivers
    unique_features = unique_features[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    
    # Compute weighted score based on effect sizes
    weights = {}
    for fid in unique_features:
        i = feats.column(fid)
        y0 = feats.x[feats.y==0, i]
        y1 = feats.x[feats.y==1, i]
        t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(y0, y1)
        weights[fid] = t_stat
    
    # Normalize weights
    w_sum = sum(abs(w) for w in weights.values())
    if w_sum > 0:
        for fid in weights:
            weights[fid] /= w_sum
    
    return Design(
        drivers=(unique_features[0],) if unique_features else (),
        columns=tuple(unique_features),
        products=(),
        loadings=weights
    )
